title: button max three words mobile full width
rule: Button label ≤3 words; verb; capital first letter; full-width on mobile, shrink-to-content on desktop. Inverted variant not on images unless contrast holds. Dual-cite Actions explicit verb; unique bits are the three-word cap and mobile full-width.
pass_when: Action labels ≤3 words, verb-first, capital first letter; small screens span the viewport; desktop width follows the label; inverted not on images unless contrast holds.
fail_when: Action label longer than three words; mobile button does not span the viewport; desktop is a fixed wide block; inverted on an image without contrast.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: One primary per view; Actions explicit-verb without the three-word cap.
